scope: Claude 2.1.310 previous-tag bare installations to sealed candidate Claude plugins, including installed-plugin session command disable and re-enable. No model prompt sent. macOS native coverage only.

reproduce.instructions: From the grey-matter checkout with pinned candidate artifact directories present, write probeSourceUtf8 exactly to .scratch/probe-claude-previous-release.mjs, then run node .scratch/probe-claude-previous-release.mjs .scratch/claude-replay.json. The probe uses disposable homes and removes them on exit. Absolute candidate paths identify this recorded run; map them to identical verified candidate artifacts for another machine. Requires installed Claude, macOS sandbox-exec, Node dependencies, bash and Git. Bootstrap downloads pinned npm dependencies into a fresh owned cache before offline native installation.

evidence.scope: Actual previous tagged bare installers migrated to current sealed Claude plugins; no historical plugin format is asserted.

npmBootstrap.scope: Fresh owned cache; public lockfile downloads before network-isolated native install. No user npm config/cache or credentials.
